title: Add setup ai and setup env for machine-wide configuration and always-on local realtime
description: Users should configure Kanbus once per machine, not per clone or worktree. Adds 'kbs setup ai' (stores an LLM API key in ~/.kanbus.env, mode 600) and 'kbs setup env NAME' (any machine-wide setting, e.g. KANBUS_REALTIME_BROKER), with --status reporting where each value comes from. Missing-key errors, doctor, and init now point at setup ai. Docs cover credential precedence (shell env, then ~/.kanbus.env, then project .env) and a boot-surviving local Mosquitto service so every worktree and agent on the machine shares realtime updates. Test suites isolate HOME so a developer's ~/.kanbus.env and live broker cannot leak in. Python and Rust in parity via features/cli/setup_ai.feature and setup_env.feature.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Shipped: setup ai and setup env merged to develop in AnthusAI/Kanbus#352 and released to main in AnthusAI/Kanbus#353. Verified live on a Mac with an always-on Mosquitto launchd service that survived a reboot.
